people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance; for the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
translations.bsb: Solomon made all these articles in such great abundance that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
translations.kjv: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
